title: Vector & Bitmap Graphic Finder
summary: Builds and edits Swami's Vector & Bitmap Graphic Finder: a vibe dashboard with a live AI tool that finds SVG, DXF, PNG, and other graphics for 3D CAD, 3D printing, CNC, laser, and plasma.
what_it_is: A Claude skill for one specific page: the **Vector & Bitmap Graphic Finder**, published as a Claude artifact. The page is a full vibe dashboard (same design, Search section, Mind Map, Glossary, and audio overview) with a live tool inside it. You describe a graphic, paste an image link, or drop an image, and Claude suggests where to find it as a vector or bitmap file.

Around the tool, the page explains search operators, what makes a good vector or bitmap, file types, how to vectorize a bitmap (with a table of tracing tools such as Potrace, Inkscape, and Vector Magic), and the finder's limits. The skill tells Claude where the page's build sources live, how to rebuild it, and which parts of the live tool must never be changed.
why: Makers who cut, carve, or print a design need a clean vector (SVG or DXF) or a high-quality bitmap. The finder turns a plain description into ranked sources and hand-off searches, and the reference sections explain what to look for and how to convert what you find.

what_it_does.text: Takes a description, an image URL, or an uploaded image and asks Claude for ranked source links, shown in a sortable results table (Source, Type, Cost, CAD notes, Link).
File-type chips (SVG, DXF, PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP) and style chips (Free only, Silhouette, Black & white, Color, Clipart), all on by default.
One-click searches on Google, Bing, Brave, and DuckDuckGo, and on the SVGrepo, FreeSVG, and Freepik vector sites, built from your description and filters.
Sections on search operators, what makes a good vector or bitmap, file types, vectorizing a bitmap, and the finder's limits and caveats.
Closed profiles, one closed shape per color, and details at least about two nozzle widths wide so the slicer keeps them.
Dashboard Summary, Search, Mind Map, a 31-term Glossary, and a spoken audio overview, all from the vibe-dashboard skill.
Rebuilds from sources published with the page (`build.txt`, `make.txt`, `tool-source.txt`, `narration.txt`, `check.txt`), so every edit is repeatable.
Can make a separate copy of the finder, or use it as the base for a similar finder tool.

triggers: "Add Vector Magic to the vectorize table in the graphic finder"
"Add a glossary term to the graphic finder"
"Make a copy of the graphic finder" / "build a similar finder for …"

how_to_use.step: Tell Claude the change you want to the finder (a new tool row, glossary term, section text), or ask for a copy.
Claude loads the vibe-dashboard skill and reads the live page's published sources into a working folder.
Content changes go in `build.py`; tool behavior changes go in `tool-source.html`.
Claude saves the live audio block if the narration won't change, then runs `make.sh` to rebuild the page and apply the vibe patches.
Claude puts the saved audio back, or rewrites the narration and records it again if sections or the glossary count changed.
Claude runs `check.py` at three widths and the privacy check.
Claude republishes to the same link with the changed source files, and says what changed in a line.
Open the page, expand Find Graphics, describe or drop an image, and run it. The first run asks you to allow Claude (and images).

how_to_use_windows.step: Building and editing run in Claude's workspace, not on your PC, so the steps are the same on Windows.
Open the finder in Edge, Chrome, or Firefox. Upload Image uses the normal Windows file picker; dragging a file from File Explorer onto the drop zone also works.
Files you get from source sites land in `C:\Users\<name>\Downloads`; open SVG in Inkscape or Illustrator, and DXF in your CAD or laser software.
The online edition exports SVG, EPS, and PDF; DXF needs the desktop edition, which runs on Windows.

The tool and its build can be copied as a starting point for a similar finder.

limitations.text: Claude can't browse from the page, so the finder suggests well-known sites and their own search pages, not exact file links.
Image URL mode often has to guess from the link text; Upload Image is the reliable way to search by picture.

The main finder button needs Claude's built-in access, so it works only on the published claude.ai page. Elsewhere (opened from disk, or built by another AI) it shows an error banner, but the search-engine and vector-site buttons still work.
The skill is built around one artifact and its published sources; a new copy needs its own permissions and audio wiring.

gotchas.text: On the finder page, body text that starts a word with a capital-S "search" turns into a link to its search section. Say "the finder" or "run it" instead.
Never name a category `search`; the Search patch owns it. The tool's color is `--cat-tool`.
`make.sh` rebuilds from scratch and drops the audio player. Save the live audio block first, or record again.
Every new narration gets the vibe-dashboard noun/verb stress audit before recording, so words like "record" and "research" are stressed correctly.
If the voice model download is cut off, delete the partial `kokoro.onnx` and retry once; then fall back to the browser voice.
The tool's controls must be skipped by glossary and section linking, or a click on a filter chip jumps to the Glossary.
Always build from the page's published sources, never an older copy; they hold every edit since the skill was last updated.
Hand-off buttons open through a real link click, because `window.open` is unreliable inside the artifact viewer.

glossary.def: A graphic made of lines and curves that scales to any size without losing sharpness.
A graphic made of a grid of pixels; it blurs or turns blocky when enlarged.
Scalable Vector Graphics, the common web vector format; most CAD and laser tools import it.
Drawing Exchange Format, the CAD vector format most CNC, laser, and plasma software reads.
A lossless bitmap format that supports transparency.
Turning a bitmap into vector paths by tracing its edges.
A free tracing engine that turns black-and-white bitmaps into smooth vectors; Inkscape uses it.
A paid automatic tracing service and desktop app known for clean, low-node results.
An outline that fully closes on itself, so CAD can extrude it into a solid.
The program that turns a 3D model into printer layers and moves.
The printer nozzle's opening, commonly 0.4 mm; it limits the finest printable detail.
A button that opens your query on another search engine or vector site in a new tab.
A special term like filetype: or site: that narrows a web search.
The artifact permission that lets a published page ask Claude a question, with images if allowed.
The files published with the page that rebuild it exactly: generator, pipeline, tool source, narration, and checker.
A web page Claude publishes on claude.ai; it starts private.

spoken._intro: This page is the skill sheet for the vector and bitmap graphic finder skill. It builds and edits Swami's graphic finder: a vibe dashboard with a lyve AI tool that finds vector and bitmap graphics for three D cad, three D printing, CNC, laser, and plasma.
spoken.Dashboard Summary: A short intro and a table of every section
spoken.What It Is: What the skill is, and why it exists: makers need a clean vector or a sharp bitmap, and the finder turns a plain description into ranked sources
spoken.What It Does: Eight things, from the lyve finder, its filters, and its hand off buttons, through the reference sections and three D printing tips, to the script that rebuilds the page
spoken.How to Use It: Eight steps, from asking for a change to using the finder. On Windows the steps are the same, with notes on uploads and downloads
spoken.Skills It Depends On: The vibe dashboard skill, which sets the design, and the artifact capabilities skill, only for a new copy
spoken.Programs It Depends On: Python, the Kokoro voice, ffmpeg, and Playwright in Claude's workspace, plus a web browser. No API key is needed
spoken.Capabilities and Limitations: It takes text, a link, or an image, and keeps working links even when Claude can't be reached. But it can't browse, and lyve search works only on the published page
spoken.Scheduled Tasks: None of its own. The audio refresh task and the nightly GitHub backup both touch the page
spoken.Where It Runs: It works in any Claude app session. Windows and mobile are untested. In other assistants it works partly: the main finder button needs Claude, but the search engine buttons still work
spoken.Gotchas: Eight traps, from a capital S that links to the wrong section, to the stress check, to the audio player that a rebuild drops
spoken.Other Requirements: Edit access to the page, code execution, viewer approval on first use, and any current browser
spoken.Card and Freshness: Which version of the skill this page describes, and its fingerprint
